name: Srikakulam

queries.query: Srikakulam Andhra Pradesh official cadastral parcel map land records GIS Bhunaksha
queries.result: First-party results identified the Government of Andhra Pradesh Bhunaksha cadastral mapping portal, the official Srikakulam district site, and the Andhra Pradesh Space Applications Centre cadastral-map viewer. The public viewer route was inspected, but no usable anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was exposed.

queries.result: The first-party discovery result set included the Telugu Srikakulam district government site and the same official Andhra Pradesh Bhunaksha land-map service. No anonymous Srikakulam parcel vector endpoint, safe schema, CRS, or bounded geometry response was found.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Government of Andhra Pradesh Department of Survey, Settlements and Land Records (Bhunaksha AP); the official Srikakulam district administration site confirms district government context. A separate city municipal cadastral custodian was not identified.
officialSourceAssessment.localRegistryOrProcedure: The state public Bhunaksha service is an official cadastral-map procedure covering Andhra Pradesh and its district data, but this attempt did not establish an open Srikakulam city parcel layer or city-specific registry endpoint.
officialSourceAssessment.regionalPublicMap: APSAC official AP GIS cadastral-map wrapper; its iframe points to an official ArcGIS Web AppBuilder application.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: First-party search result describes Bhunaksha AP as Government of Andhra Pradesh cadastral mapping software integrating land records and geo-referenced spatial data; no parcel response was obtained from the search result alone.
Anonymous curl request timed out after 30 seconds. The timeout was not treated as absence. No credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.
The official viewer route was identified by the first-party redirect, but a direct anonymous HTTPS request timed out after 15 seconds; no viewer configuration or parcel query was executed.

Anonymous HTTPS GET returned the official district site. It identifies Srikakulam district administration and provides Telugu/English site routes, but no cadastral parcel-vector API or safe parcel schema.
Anonymous HTTPS GET returned the official APSAC cadastral-map wrapper and iframe URL https://apsac.ap.gov.in/gisportal/apps/webappviewer/index.html?id=7e3b53a1a265421483fbcbb26c275834.

Current Web AppBuilder configuration was inspected. map.itemId is empty, mapOptions are the generic [-98,40] default, and no operationalLayers/service URL was present; therefore no bounded anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry request was possible.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: APSAC Web AppBuilder config.json retrieved; no configured map item or operational layer URL.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: Exact WUP point [18.297920027956, 83.8946419107167] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift or parcel query was used.
boundedAnonymousResponse.result: No public parcel-vector route was exposed by the reachable official viewer configuration, so no bounded ID-plus-geometry response was executed or retained.
